events.description: Married Joseph Daniel Callaghan, 39, clerk, of 500 Bergen Ave, Jersey City NJ (b. Mayfield PA; son of John M. Callaghan, b. England, and Catherine Killer, b. St. Clair PA, both dead). Luzerne licence No. 1829 C was sworn 10 Oct and issued 17 Oct 1936. She was 36, a bookkeeper, of 16 Barney St. Her father is given as Henry Joseph, molder, b. Germany, and her mother as Anna Higgins, b. New Philadelphia, PA. [R4-S1]

bio: Madeline's 1936 marriage application was sworn on 10 Oct 1936 ([R4-S1]). She was a 36-year-old bookkeeper living at home at 16 Barney Street. She married Joseph Daniel Callaghan, a 39-year-old clerk from Jersey City, on 24 Oct 1936 at Wilkes-Barre. The licence states plainly that her father Henry Joseph, a molder, was born in Germany. It also gives a new clue for the Irish side: her mother Anna Higgins was born at New Philadelphia, Schuylkill County ([R4-S1]). The couple settled in Lyndhurst, New Jersey. FamilySearch has her death there on 20 Jan 1995 and burial at St Mary's, Hanover Twp. Joseph died in 1961 ([R4-S2]).
openQuestions: Anna Higgins's birthplace is given as New Philadelphia, PA (1936). Pass this to the Irish/Higgins line.
